title: Rules
intro: Rules hide or boost articles in every list. They take effect straight away.

empty.title: No rules yet
empty.body: Mute, block or boost from an article's menu, or add a rule below.

expires.soon: Expires in less than a minute

delete.title: Delete this rule?
delete.body: {{kind}}: {{value}}. Bantoozi will stop applying it and rank your articles again.

mute_keyword.label: Keyword or phrase
mute_keyword.hint: Hides articles whose title or summary contains it. Use {{min}} to {{max}} characters.

block_domain.label: Domain
block_domain.hint: Hides every article from this website, for example example.com.

boost_domain.label: Domain
boost_domain.hint: Always shows articles from this website in For you, for example example.com.

block_author.label: Author name
block_author.hint: Hides articles written by this author.

errors.domain: Enter a website name such as example.com, without http:// or a path.
errors.author: Use at most {{max}} characters.
